settings.hidden_basis: browser verdict of the displayed route
settings.hidden_text: kept in place (typed source reading), hidden as the browser proved it 55eb6759a2630550
settings.lists: the parser's own list items: list, ordered, item
settings.nested_tables: each a table unit naming its holder cell
settings.paragraph_membership: kept where one of the tool's paragraphs becomes several units
settings.punctuation: as the source writes it: no white space removed before . , ; ! ? and none added after . ! ?
settings.source_inline: per source run under a sup or sub, a plain inline box with any non-baseline vertical-align, another inline box with vertical-align super, sub or a number, or a positioned inline box (computed position not static): nearest-first ancestors; a positioned one adds its raw computed position, top, bottom, left and right
settings.source_style: per source run: colour, weight, font style, decorations in effect, text transform (the computed property, never a printed string), raw background stack with opacity; the raw native client rectangles of the whole run (boxes), the source extent they measure where it differs (boxes_at), and their one frame (viewport, scroll, device pixel ratio)
settings.table_captions: each table's own caption a caption unit, bound to its source caption
settings.table_cells: every own cell, bound to its source cell, in its row's source order
settings.table_header: header is the tool's own verdict (EdgarTools 5.60.0 TableProcessor), read unchanged; a cell's tag, its attrs (id, scope, headers as the parser reads them: character references decoded) and its row_group (the cell's own source group, carried through re-gridding; its tag in the table's row_group_tags) are the source's statements; an absent tag, attrs entry or group is unknown
settings.table_identity: own start tag, shown or hidden
settings.table_rows: every own row, empty ones too, in the table model order (its header group, bodies as written, its footer group); a span ends with its row group
